campaign.design: parallel, six workflow-exclusive workers (user-directed amendment 2026-09-01; same-workflow sessions never overlap)
campaign.runtimes_measure: delivered workflow under concurrent campaign load

corpus.definition: audit slice of the 241 registered Exp-24 runs (210 RNADesign-210 tasks + 31 PA sessions, latest-record-wins, success required)

representative_session.rule: multi-turn PA sessions; most distinct gate verdict types; ties -> median event count; residual ties -> lowest PA number

manifest.selection_rule: payload.session_id in corpus sessions (tool_call); workflow-key attribution for unstamped gate/ranking/claim events (workflow-exclusive parallel campaign: same-workflow sessions never overlap; ambiguity fails); choke-point adjacency fallback for keyless gate events; events resolving to no corpus session are excluded

assertions_passed: every corpus session has >=1 stamped audit event
0 unstamped tool_call events inside the campaign span
all gate verdicts in {reject, require_profiling, downgrade, allow}

amendment.disclosure: All other 240 corpus sessions retain their original frozen events byte-identically; the original analyzer's quiet-trail freeze assertions cannot be re-asserted against the now-busy audit trail, hence the surgical replacement registered here.
